subject: Interop playbook workshop — technical deep-dive coordination
messages:
From: Rune Larsen <rune@cloudforge.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Petrova <elena@marketplace-partner.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@stratussys.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Partner integration runbook workshop

Hi Karthik —

Hope you’re well. CloudForge would like to set up a joint technical runbook workshop with Redwood and StratusSys (our SI) to align on the integration surface, marketplace packaging requirements, and ops runbook (deploy, rollback, monitoring). We’re aiming for ~2 hours: architecture review + hands-on mapping to the runbook template.

Proposed dates (our engineers available):
- Thu Apr 15, 09:00–11:00 PT / 12:00–14:00 ET
- Fri Apr 16, 13:00–15:00 PT / 16:00–18:00 ET

Attendees from our side: Rune (partner lead), Elena (marketplace PM), Tim (SI technical lead). Would you be able to confirm a slot and the Redwood architects who should join?

Attaching a short integration-overview.pdf for context (attachment).

Thanks —
Rune
Partner Alliances | CloudForge
[rune@cloudforge.io]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rune Larsen <rune@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner integration runbook workshop

Thanks Rune — really appreciate the context and the PDF. Unfortunately Apr 15 conflicts with a leadership offsite for the infra team; Apr 16 is tricky for a couple of our engineers. Can we shift this to the week of Apr 20? Two windows that work for the core architects:

Option A: Tue Apr 20, 10:00–12:00 PT (13:00–15:00 ET)
Option B: Thu Apr 22, 08:00–10:00 PT (11:00–13:00 ET)

Notes / asks:
- Please confirm which technical topics you most want to prioritize (model hosting runtime, KV cache handoff, auth/KMS flow, and marketplace packaging are our guesses).
- Can you ensure Tim (SI lead) has a network diagram and a sample IaC snippet for the deployment path? That’ll make the hands-on mapping faster.
- We should have someone from marketplace product who can speak to listing acceptance criteria — cc’ing Camila for that.

I attached a proposed-agenda.docx with a short structure: 30m arch review, 60m runbook mapping, 30m actions + owners. If Option A works for you, we’ll lock the calendar and I’ll add the invite.

Karthik
Head of Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: Rune Larsen <rune@cloudforge.io>, Elena Petrova <elena@marketplace-partner.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 08:30:00 +0100
Subject: Fwd: Re: Partner integration runbook workshop — tentative hold

Forwarding to confirm — I’ve placed a tentative hold on Tue Apr 20, 10:00–12:00 PT on the Redwood team calendar and created a draft invite. Please review calendar invite and update your attendee list.

Attachments: runbook-template.xlsx (attachment)

From: Elena Petrova <elena@marketplace-partner.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Rune Larsen <rune@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Tim Chen <tim.chen@stratussys.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Apr 2026 17:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Partner integration runbook workshop — pre-read and marketplace checklist

Thanks all — Apr 20 works for CloudForge and StratusSys. We’ll join with the marketplace checklist and a short deck on listing requirements. Pre-read items for the Redwood team:

- CloudForge listing expectations (short doc) — see https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cRunbookPreRead
- HubSpot product record for the integration: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/CloudForge-9876

I’ve attached a one-page checklist and noted the items we’d like to confirm during the workshop (billing metadata, entitlement headers, KMS key access patterns). Also — Tim will bring a draft network diagram.

Quick Q: Do you prefer Zoom or our internal Webex for the hands-on portion (sharing terminals for the IaC snippet)? Zoom is simpler for external attendees; we can use that.

Best,
Elena Petrova
Marketplace Partnerships | CloudForge

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Rune Larsen <rune@cloudforge.io>, Elena Petrova <elena@marketplace-partner.com>, Tim Chen <tim.chen@stratussys.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Apr 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner integration runbook workshop — final confirmation

Thanks everyone — locking Tue Apr 20, 10:00–12:00 PT (Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210). Final checklist / owners:

- Architecture & runtime constraints: Sergio Alvarez (Redwood)
- Marketplace acceptance criteria: Camila Reyes (Redwood)
- SI deployment path & network diagram: Tim Chen (StratusSys)
- Partner listing reqs + billing metadata: Elena Petrova (CloudForge)
- Runbook template / actions capture: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood)

Please add any additional agenda items to the Drive folder and upload the IaC snippet ahead of the meeting so Tim and Sergio can step through it live. I’ll send the calendar invite with the Zoom link and a short agenda doc.

See you then —
Karthik
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
